{{< fa basket-shopping >}} Ingredients

 12 lacewing flies, stewed for 21 days
 1 ounce of fresh fluxweed, picked at full moon
 3 measures of knotgrass
 4 leeches
 1 powdered horn of bicorn
 1 measure of boomslang skin, shredded
 1 small piece from intended transformation target (hair recommended)

{{< fa kitchen-set >}} Procedure

Begin by stewing the lacewing flies for 21 days in a copper cauldron
Once flies are properly stewed, add the fluxweed and knotgrass
Stir three times clockwise and let simmer for 80 minutes
Add leeches one at a time, stirring counterclockwise between each addition
Sprinkle in powdered bicorn horn while maintaining a steady simmer
Add shredded boomslang skin and stir five times clockwise
Let potion brew for 24 hours until it has a thick, mud-like consistency
Add the piece from transformation target just before drinking
Consume within 10 minutes of adding final ingredient

Note: This potion is highly complex and takes approximately one month to prepare correctly. Effects last for one hour.
